notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
-Fixed issue of falling though Abbadon level.
-Fixed controller support on menus.
-Fixed falling endlessly on the final level.
-Other small quality of life issues.

Still working on some known bugs, such as leaving a level before killing a boss and retaining power-up. Thank you all for your patience!

notes.title: Day one Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey friends, sorry about the few bugs that made it past the beta testers and I!
If you find any, please contact me and let me know the troubles you ran into!

I'll be rolling out a patch at the end of the day to fix what I can!
Thanks for being understanding! :)

-Radcroc
